query: Which prospective validation designs (pre-registered cohort, stepped-wedge, simulated review, or hybrid) optimize safety evidence, feasibility, and regulatory acceptability?

response.query: Which prospective validation designs (pre-registered cohort, stepped-wedge, simulated review, or hybrid) optimize safety evidence, feasibility, and regulatory acceptability?
response.answer: The stepped-wedge design optimizes safety evidence, feasibility, and regulatory acceptability for implementation studies. It allows gradual rollout, enabling evaluation of intervention impact and real-time adjustments. It's widely accepted for complex interventions.

results.title: Emerging AI- and Biomarker-Driven Precision Medicine in Autoimmune Rheumatic Diseases: From Diagnostics to Therapeutic Decision-Making
results.content: Recent translational advances demonstrate that AI tools are no longer confined to experimental settings but are beginning to enhance clinical decision-making across major AIRDs. In rheumatoid arthritis, transformer-based ultrasound models have achieved near-expert accuracy for detecting synovitis and quantifying power Doppler signal, effectively standardizing disease-activity scoring and reducing inter-reader variability [[95](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B95-rheumato-05-00017)]. Time-series ML frameworks have been increasingly applied to forecast fluctuations in disease activity by integrating longitudinal measurements of validated composite indices, including the Disease Activity Score in 28 joints (DAS28) and the Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI), with continuous streams of patient-generated health data from wearables and smartphones ([Figure 2](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#fig_body_display_rheumato-05-00017-f002)) [[120](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B120-rheumato-05-00017),[121](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B121-rheumato-05-00017)].
